analysis: The attempt failed source validation with a syntax error at line 71 because literal merge separators (`=======`) remained in the code. The host allocated 0 GPU seconds; no training or validation HR@10 was obtained. Additional defects include using x, mask, valid, and positions before initialization and duplicated embedding operations. Remove merge artifacts, retain one item embedding, remove positional embeddings, and initialize the padding mask before embedding and dropout. This failure provides no evidence of validation improvement.
code_summary: Intended architecture: position-free causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings and eight residual blocks using dilations [1, 2, 4, 8, 1, 2, 4, 8]. Each block applies left-padded width-3 convolutions, LayerNorm, GELU with sigmoid gating, dropout 0.2, and a learnable per-channel residual scale initialized to 0.1. Padding masks suppress padded states. Final LayerNorm produces sequence representations; training and candidate scoring use dot products with item embeddings, with candidate scoring selecting the last nonpadding state. Preserve all existing interfaces and hyperparameters.
